title: What Trevor Lawrence's rise can teach us about NFL quarterbacks
channel_name: The Athletic Football Show: A show about the NFL
text: Accompanied reading: Sando's 2026 quarterback tiers https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/interactive/nfl-quarterback-tiers-insider-rankings-2026/ Trevor Lawrence was the most baleyhooed quarterback coming out of college since Andrew Luck, seemingly a true can't-miss prospect. Until he missed. And then in year five of his career, when he seemingly was going to go down as a player who never lived up to the hype, he put it all together and finished fifth in MVP voting. title: Is Drake Maye having a crisis of confidence? And how do the Patriots cure what ails him?
channel_name: All 32 NFL Podcast w/ Mike Giardi
text: After a horrid showing vs the Jacksonville Jaguars on Sunday afternoon, Drake Maye has been facing immense criticism for his multi-interception performance. Boston Sports Journal’s Mike Giardi is joined by Andy Hart to dive deep into Maye’s play this season. It's not a pretty picture. Does the Patriots QB need to take a seat to get mentally right? Are the reasons for his struggles now being used as excuses? How much blame falls on the head coach and the offensive coordinator? And is there trouble brewing behind the scenes?
